description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in REBINDING does NOT carry Option 50 (Requested IP Address) (RFC 2131 §4.3.6 table 5)
approach:
[Objective]
Like RENEWING REQUEST_07: the rebound IP lives in ciaddr, so Option 50 is redundant and disallowed. Table 5 in RFC 2131 §4.3.6 marks Option 50 as MUST NOT in rebinding.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST.
3. T2 → REBINDING → rebind DHCPREQUEST
   • options blob does NOT contain Option 50   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No Option 50 inside the REBINDING REQUEST options blob.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_carries_requested_ip — REQUEST illegally carries Option 50.

verdicts.Pass: REBINDING REQUEST has no Option 50 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_request_carries_requested: DUT rebinding REQUEST illegally carries Option 50
